case.caveats: VERBATIM NOTE: the forward and reverse primers are printed inside a SINGLE Table 1 cell as two lines (forward above reverse, separated by a line break in the published layout / a <break/> element in the JATS full text). The split was taken at that printed line break; the in-silico product landing at exactly the printed 102 bp independently confirms the split is correct. TEMPLATE: L39390 flat file records mol_type="genomic DNA", organelle="plastid:chloroplast", with ndhF annotated as a single uninterrupted CDS 1..2226 - so there is no splicing consideration at all and the assay behaves identically on cDNA and on chloroplast DNA. This is the cleanest case in the set. In-silico check: forward matches once at position 510, reverse-complement of the reverse primer matches once ending at 611; product 510..611 = 102 bp, exact match, no alternative products. The paper states all primer pairs amplified a single PCR product of the expected size and that cloned amplicons were sequenced; NADHD was NOT among the genes flagged as differing from the GenBank design sequence (only ACT/EF at 1 bp and H3 at 18 bp were). Chloroplast is high-copy in vivo, but the locus is single-copy within this accession.
case.citation: Maroufi A, Van Bockstaele E, De Loose M. Validation of reference genes for gene expression analysis in chicory (Cichorium intybus) using quantitative real-time PCR. BMC Mol Biol. 2010;11:15. doi:10.1186/1471-2199-11-15. PMID 20156357; PMCID PMC2830926.
case.element: Non-TE control assay. Chloroplast ndhF (NADH dehydrogenase subunit F) used as a candidate RT-qPCR reference gene.
case.loci_justification: The pair flanks one locus on the cited template: a single insertion site, a single excision site, or a single transcript. A second product on this template would be an off-target prediction.
case.name: Chicory chloroplast ndhF (NADHD) reference-gene RT-qPCR assay
case.where_in_paper: Table 1 ("Selected candidate reference genes, primers and different parameters derived from qRT-PCR analysis"), row NADHD: primer sequences in the "Primer sequences (forward/reverse)" column, accession L39390 in the "GenBank accession number" column, 102 in the "Amplicon length (bp)" column. Product verification described under "Verification of amplicons, primer specificity, Cp data collection and gene-specific PCR amplification efficiency" (Figure 1a agarose gel, Figure 1b melting curves).
case.worked_prediction_note: The entry records a worked prediction — a coordinate range, an in-silico check, or a sequence-derived length — so the expected answer was written down before the engine ran. The published size remains external, but this case was not scored blind.
